name: forge
description: Lightweight Claude Code framework for solo founders — 21 skills, 12 subagents, 13 templates for shipping real products with structure, not friction.

scripts.validate: bash -n setup.sh forge lib/*.sh && for f in templates/github-workflows/*.yml templates/phases.template.yaml; do python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('$f'))" || exit 1; done
